Cc: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Today/tomorrow
Hey, Anthony: No freelancer for today/tomorrow.
George is unavailable and so are my backup backup options.
I’m good taking wires today, no question. However, it’s worth you being at the park tomorrow just for 40-man expansion. Plan on being there on Monday, too.
Let me know if there are any issues.
Are you going to KC/Oakland? That might be the best window for you to get your work done.
Chris Thomas
Sports editor, Detroit Free Press
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
cdthomas@freepress.com
